chunks: What was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Abi Ja'far, from his father, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from Ja'far, from his father, from 'Ali عليه السلام, who said:

The woman in postnatal bleeding refrains for forty days; then if she becomes pure [before that, she acts accordingly], otherwise she performs ghusl (ritual bath), prays, and her husband may approach her. She is in the position of the mustahadah: she fasts and performs salat (prayer).

key_terms.اَلنُّفَسَاءُ: a woman in the state of postnatal bleeding
key_terms.اَلْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ: a woman experiencing irregular non-menstrual bleeding
key_terms.تَقْعُدُ: she refrains from the acts suspended by postnatal bleeding

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on postnatal bleeding after forty days in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning nifas (postnatal bleeding), stating a forty-day period and then describing the woman's obligations if the bleeding continues. It clarifies that after that point she is treated like a mustahadah, so acts of worship and marital relations resume under that ruling.
